input.situation: Part B of a two-part change was opened on top of part A's branch and marked "retarget to main once part A merges". Part A was squash-merged and its branch was deleted by the merge. Part B is now closed, its base branch no longer exists, and its commits are not in main. The log does not say whether part B was ever meant to ship.
options: reopen the branch from the reflog and retarget it at main
drop part B and re-file it as its own Work
leave it closed and record why in the contract

source: v1: isnadi-bot #101 (squash-merged, branch deleted) and #102 (stacked on it, closed, commits lost) - the stacked-merge branch loss in the architecture's problem table. §10's retarget rule did not exist then; whether the work should ship at all is a scope call, which §5.3 escalates.
